capabilities: add locations from search, the map, external services, or device GPS
display paths in GeoJSON, GPX, KML, and TCX formats
draw locations and shapes on the map in edit mode
calculate driving, cycling, and walking routes between points
query and filter markers with a boolean query language
disambiguation: Not just a passive map viewer; it also lets you draw locations and shapes, edit markers, and calculate routes.
extras: Full documentation is hosted externally at esm7.github.io/obsidian-map-view; the README only lists features and installation.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to visualize, edit, or query geographic locations stored in notes on a map.
summary: Interactive map view that finds geolocations and paths in your notes and turns them into a personal GIS.
